global_training: Only v2 steady rows from other deployments. The SAME global fit evaluates strict and extended test subsets.
calibration_model: Bias-only: median of all accepted calibration path-row log residuals; no affine model or model selection.

selection.safety_rationale: Conservative planning surrogate only: prior isolated Qwen backlog begins near u=.3. Prefer <=.2 with a single resident; cap every model at .4 with multiple residents. Residency does not guarantee safety. Reveal selected probes and reject non-steady configurations; never replace them using test labels.
selection.first_anchor: Up to three distinct lowest planning-risk anchors; deterministic sort by numeric features, not observed labels.
selection.risk: max model standalone demand + .05 * max(0, request-rate-weighted global predicted log amplification)
selection.distance: Euclidean RMS of request-rate-weighted planning feature vectors standardized ONLY on global training configurations.
selection.later_points: Greedy farthest-first distance from previously selected configurations; numeric-feature tie break.
selection.fixed_test: Reserve full nested calibration chain up to supported max K; all other configurations form a fixed test set for every K in that trial.
selection.unsupported: Never split repetitions to obtain test data; K unavailable if insufficient safe candidates or independent test configurations.
selection.reveal_gate: A chosen configuration contributes residuals only if ALL its runs are steady under the current threshold setting. Rejected probes still consume budget and are never moved to test or replaced.
selection.repetitions: Use all available repetitions of each selected configuration; record run count and measurement-seconds cost. K counts configurations, not single runs.

sensitivity_scope: Relabel AND rerun fixed global/calibration procedure at each factor; hard instability thresholds unchanged. No retuning.
metric_comparison: Paired global and local predictions on identical held-out test configurations. Equal-deployment macro of trial means; report std and worst case.
win: Trial-mean MAE improves at least 10% AND trial-mean sMAPE does not increase.
worst_collapse: Any trial local MAE >2x its matched global MAE AND >50 ms increase.
PASS: Same K on >=5 strict folds; repairs BOTH original GBT non-win contexts; >=80% no harm; >=10% macro MAE improvement, no worse macro sMAPE, no worst collapse; extended macro no >10% harm; all warning settings agree.
PARTIAL: Not PASS; at least two strict or extended folds have substantive mean improvement at some K in nominal thresholds.
FAIL: No stable evidence of benefit by the above rule; do not add calibration model complexity.
original_failure_definition: Complement of Module 2D primary C_gbt_log_ratio substantive-win contexts (not the separate Ridge failures).
